LanguageData.Gun_RPKS_RWP.description: The RPKS is a light machine gun known for its durability and reliability. It offers a solid balance of firepower and efficiency, featuring a high rate of fire suitable for suppressing enemies in mid-range combat. Although it has moderate accuracy and recoil, the RPKS excels in sustained engagements where consistent fire is key. A favorite among those who prioritize endurance on the battlefield.
